<thought>To obtain the appropriate retrosynthetic template, we can search the template catalog using only the functional‑group criteria that are valid in the system. The target molecule is the provided SMILES, and the reaction breaks a ketone and a C‑C double bond while forming an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring. Using these functional‑group specifications should return the desired template(s).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"],
    "limit": 5
}
